data.title: 拉姆 · 修剪玫瑰
data.description: 庭院的玫瑰长过了篱笆。拉姆抬手剪下一枝，另一只手托住花茎，免得刺刮到袖口。
data.promptProse: Along the trimmed rose hedge of the Roswaal mansion garden on a quiet afternoon, Ram stands carefully in her maid uniform tending an overgrown branch. She holds a blooming red rose stem steady between the fingers of one hand to keep thorns clear of her cuff while clipping cleanly below the leaves with steel garden shears. Dappled sunlight filters through overhead tree boughs onto the dark foliage and her crisp white apron.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the mansion rose hedge in her maid uniform, Ram steadies a crimson rose stem with one hand while trimming it cleanly with steel garden shears. Dappled afternoon sunlight falls through overhead leaves onto the blooms.
